verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a hosted card-issuing and processing platform. A buyer could fairly ask whether such a platform can be deployed on-premises, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted, on-premises or downloadable deployment of the core product. The option to authorize transactions with your own authorizer instead of Pomelo's credit core or Autorizador is an adjacent integration choice, not self-hosting the core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
